note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: Torrey's working verses (Rom 3:23, 6:23, Isa 53:5-6, John 3:16, 3:36, 1:12, 5:40, Gal 3:10, 1 Tim 1:15, Rom 5:8, Jer 29:13, Luke 13:3, 1 Cor 1:18, 2:14, Acts 2:38-39, 1 John 5:14-15, James 1:6-7) and the phrases he quotes again inside his questions.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Inner quotations are ‹ ›. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and, chiefly, Torrey's own catechism: the questions he puts to the inquirer and the answers he draws out ('What is the wages of sin?', 'I am under the curse'). Where OWB rewords the verse a question is built on, the question was reworded to match (Gal 3:10 'continueth not … cursed' → OWB «አጥብቆ የማይይዝና የማያደርግ ሁሉ እርግማን አለበት»; Isa 53:6 'gone astray' → «ተሳስተን ሄድን»; John 8:34 'continues to commit sin'; 1 Tim 1:15 'chief' → 'worst'; Prov 29:1 'suddenly' → «በቅጽበት»; Jer 2:5 'iniquity' → 'fault').

Judgement calls. Acts 2:39 'the promise' is OWB «ተስፋው», and Torrey's three later uses of the term follow it (decision the-promise). Torrey's direction to read Isa 53:5 in the singular ('wounded for MY transgressions') keeps OWB's words with the pronouns turned, self_rendered. Ps 14:1 is cited only in fragments («እግዚአብሔር የለም», «በልቡ») inside Torrey's argument and stays as allusion.
